name: TESSERA Geneware Consultation Blazer
description: Worn by TESSERA's client-facing geneware consultation staff, this blazer is itself a subtle advertisement for the company's capabilities. The fabric is a structured bioluminescent silk-synthetic blend — a TESSERA proprietary material called Lumivex — that shifts through a slow, barely perceptible spectrum of pale blues and greens when the wearer is under warm light, mimicking the aesthetic of bioluminescent geneware modifications. Cut in a fitted, gender-neutral silhouette with a standing collar, it accommodates horn clearance via a recessed crown seam and has reinforced shoulder fabric that lies flat over subdermal implants. The TESSERA double-helix sigil is embroidered at the left cuff in thread that fluoresces under near-UV light.
cultural_context: TESSERA consultation staff are aspirational figures in Tier 3 neighborhoods — they represent access to transformation, to bodies that are chosen rather than inherited. The blazer is recognized on sight and usually earns deference, though in some communities it signals corporate body-commodity culture and gets a colder reception.
story_hooks: A counterfeit version of the blazer is circulating, worn by someone running an unlicensed geneware consultation scam out of a Tier 2 back room.
A consultation staff member in the blazer is found dead in a Tier 1 district with no explanation for what brought them there.
The Lumivex fabric has an undisclosed secondary function — it passively logs biometric data from nearby individuals and transmits it to TESSERA servers.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, structured blazer that catches light with an otherworldly shimmer. Fitted through the torso with a sharp standing collar that frames the face. The silhouette is deliberately androgynous—shoulders sit clean and geometric without aggressive padding. Under warm light, the fabric seems to breathe through pale blue-to-green iridescence, creating the subtle impression of living bioluminescence beneath the skin.
physical_description.fit: Tailored and fitted but not restrictive. Cut to accommodate enhanced physiology: horn clearance via recessed crown seam at the back, and reinforced shoulder panels that drape smoothly over subdermal implant architecture without bunching or distortion.
physical_description.primary_material: Lumivex—a proprietary bioluminescent silk-synthetic blend developed by TESSERA. Smooth to the touch with a subtle structured weave that resists creasing.
physical_description.texture: Silky and almost liquid in appearance, with a faint quilted texture at reinforced zones. The fabric has a gentle sheen that shifts as the wearer moves, creating an almost living quality.
physical_description.color_scheme: Predominantly cool neutral charcoal-grey base with bioluminescent blue-to-green shifts under warm light. The effect is subtle—almost subliminal unless you're looking for it. The left cuff features a fluorescent double-helix embroidery that glows pale cyan under near-UV light.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap buttons at the front, arranged in a standard three-button configuration. Closures are seamless and barely visible when fastened, maintaining the clean silhouette.
distinctive_features: Bioluminescent Lumivex fabric that subtly shifts blue-green in warm light
Standing collar with recessed crown seam for horn clearance
Reinforced shoulder panels designed to sit flat over subdermal implants
Double-helix sigil embroidered at left cuff in near-UV fluorescent thread
Recessed side pockets that don't disrupt the fitted line
Magnetic closures instead of traditional buttons for a seamless look
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 aspirational professional. The blazer signals stable corpo employment and access to bespoke biotech—it's affordable enough for working-class professionals but expensive enough to denote status within that tier.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by TESSERA's client-facing geneware consultation staff. The blazer is a walking advertisement for the company's capabilities and a symbol of bodily autonomy and chosen transformation. In affluent neighborhoods, it commands respect and opens doors. In lower-tier communities, it can signal complicity with corporate body-commodification, earning wariness or resentment from those who cannot afford such modifications.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. TESSERA provides cleaning and maintenance as part of employment benefits. Fabric resists visible wear due to its synthetic durability. Bioluminescent properties remain consistent across the garment's lifespan.
